item.title: Spanish Love Songs Working on LP5
item.description: Spanish Love Songs have given an update on their new album: Chris Walla & Sarah Tudzin are each producing half of the record. Sarah is mixing as well. I wrote 15ish decent songs for it (and a lot of bad ideas prior). Probably recording 13. Putting 10 on the thing in a perfect world.

item.title: Magnolia Park Announce New Album
item.description: Magnolia Park will release Nights After Vamp on March 13th. Today they’ve shared “High.” Today, the heavy genre-bending five-piece Magnolia Park announce NIGHTS AFTER VAMP, the deluxe version of their ambitious concept album VAMP released last Spring.
